gaps.explanation: No business-type schedule exists; the Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Fund Net Position - Proprietary Funds (printed p19) prints enterprise columns 'Electric Fund' and 'Water Fund' on trimmed p8 and 'Sewer Fund' and 'Nursing Home Fund' (plus Total) on trimmed p9. JSON receipts = total operating revenues 381,404 + interest income 5,680 + grant income 56,017. Electric: Lease revenues 101,009 + Interest income 352 = 101,361. Water: Sales 168,221 + Other revenue 348 + Interest income 3,429 + Grant income 56,017 = 228,015. Sewer: Sales 105,708 + Other revenue 118 + Interest income 1,015 = 106,841. Nursing Home: Lease revenues 6,000 + Interest income 884 = 6,884. 0 + 101,361 + 228,015 + 106,841 + 6,884 = 443,101 = statement total.
